title: Praised by Shiva
translation: O Supreme Goddess, praised by the lord of the daughter of the Himalaya (Shiva)! Give me beauty, give me victory, give me glory, destroy my enemies.
translation_hi: हे परमेश्वरी, हिमालय की पुत्री के स्वामी शिव द्वारा स्तुत। मुझे रूप दीजिए, जय दीजिए, यश दीजिए, शत्रुओं का नाश कीजिए।
grammar: Acala = mountain: 'the unmoving', the same word as the 'still' stars in Āryabhaṭa's boat verse.
Refrain: रूपं देहि जयं देहि यशो देहि द्विषो जहि 'Give me beauty, give me victory, give me glory, destroy my enemies.'
